issues.title: The dropdown list of Force should have all force of game
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
The dropdown list of Force should have all force of game 

**Update from Ian:** See my analysis of the problem in this issue: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/issues/2809.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk with role Game Designer / Umpire
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Create a new item
4. Notice it shows the selected default is 'f-red', but the item is drawing with color 'Gray'. Although the game has 5 forces

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/60e9c261-53d4-4238-8285-b5eb1d63369d)

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/45145317-cdb4-425b-a851-f93d1bb9fcde)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
The dropdown list of Force should have all force of game. And created item from the force should have default force is the current force (example above case, the default should be 'Umpire') 

## 🖥️ Screencast

## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
